chest_press.end: Arms pressed forward almost straight, elbow flexion ~10–15°, shoulders protracted, back still against pad, hands pushing handles forward inline with chest.
chest_press.muscles: Pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, triceps brachii
chest_press.setup: Selectorized seated chest-press machine with upright padded backrest; seat adjusted so handles align with mid-chest; feet flat on floor, back fully against pad.
chest_press.start: Hands on handles beside chest, elbows ~45° from torso, elbow flexion ~90°, shoulders neutral, torso upright, back pressed to pad, load at chest level.

croci_cavi.end: Arms horizontally adducted, hands meet in front of lower chest/upper abdomen, elbows maintain slight bend ~15°, torso stable and slightly inclined forward.
croci_cavi.setup: Two high cable pulleys, one handle in each hand; standing between pulleys with one foot staggered forward, torso inclined slightly forward (~10–20°).
croci_cavi.start: Arms abducted wide to the sides at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent ~10–20°, palms facing forward, shoulders level, cables taut.

stacco_bil.end: Hips and knees fully extended, hips thrust forward, torso upright (near vertical), shoulders back, bar close to thighs at hip height.
stacco_bil.setup: Straight Olympic barbell with bumper plates on floor; feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot, grip double overhand or mixed, shins near bar.
stacco_bil.start: Hips and knees flexed (hips ~45°), knees ~90° flexion, torso inclined ~40–50° with neutral spine, chest up, shoulders slightly in front of bar, hands outside knees on bar.

lat_machine.end: Bar pulled to upper chest, elbows down and back, shoulder blades drawn together, torso slightly leaned back with chest lifted.
lat_machine.muscles: Latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, lower back (erector spinae)
lat_machine.setup: Seated at lat pulldown machine, thighs locked under knee pads, long wide bar on high cable, grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
lat_machine.start: Arms fully extended overhead holding bar wide, shoulders elevated slightly, torso upright with chest up, knees under pads, back neutral.

alzate_laterali.end: Arms abducted laterally to shoulder height (~90°), elbows still slightly bent ~20°, palms facing down or slightly forward, shoulder level.
alzate_laterali.setup: Pair of hex dumbbells at sides, standing feet hip-width, knees soft, torso upright, neutral grip at start (thumbs slightly facing forward).
alzate_laterali.start: Arms at sides holding dumbbells, elbows slightly bent ~15°, palms facing inward, shoulders relaxed, spine neutral.

curl_bil.end: Elbows flexed ~90–100°, bar near upper chest/clavicle, forearms vertical, shoulders stable, elbows remain at the sides.
curl_bil.setup: Standing with straight barbell held in supinated grip, hands shoulder-width, feet hip-width, knees soft, torso upright.
curl_bil.start: Arms fully extended, elbows pinned to sides, wrists neutral, shoulders relaxed, bar at thigh level.

squat_bil.end: Hips pushed back and down until thighs at least parallel (hips ~90° flexion), knees ~90° flexion, torso leaned forward ~20–30°, weight through whole foot.
squat_bil.setup: Straight barbell resting on upper trapezius, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out, weight distributed evenly across foot.
squat_bil.start: Standing tall: hips and knees extended, spine neutral, chest up, shoulders over hips.

leg_press.end: Legs pushed out almost straight with knees soft (~10–15° flexion), hips extended, feet flat, spine and hips pressed to seat.
leg_press.setup: 45° leg-press machine: reclined padded seat, feet shoulder-width on inclined sled platform, hips and back pressed to seat.
leg_press.start: Knees deeply flexed with hips close to chest (~90–100° knee flexion), shins angled, torso supported against seat, feet flat on platform.

leg_curl.end: Knees flexed to about 110°, heels drawn toward the glutes, hips remain anchored on pad, femurs stationary, torso unchanged.
leg_curl.setup: Lying face down on the machine bench, hips centered on the hip pad, roller pad positioned just above the heels, feet neutral, hands gripping the bench or handles at sides.
leg_curl.start: Torso flat on bench, hips anchored on pad, legs fully extended, knees ~0° (straight), ankles neutral, hands holding handles.

hip_thrust_bil.end: Hips fully extended so torso and thighs form a near-horizontal line, pelvis level with shoulders, knees ~90°, glutes maximally contracted, hands stabilizing the bar.
hip_thrust_bil.setup: Upper back (scapulae) braced on a flat bench, barbell with pad resting across the pelvis, feet flat hip-width, knees bent ~90°, toes pointing forward.
hip_thrust_bil.start: Hips lowered so pelvis near the floor, torso angled ~45° to the floor, bar resting on pelvis, shins vertical, knees ~90°, hands stabilizing the bar.
